caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a man standing with one foot resting on a light blue decorative pedestal accented with leaf and scroll patterns. The man wears a light brown tunic with a patterned border at the sleeves, matching brown leggings, and a light blue cap. His collar is white, and his facial hair is brown and full, with long brown hair. The figure holds a long, upright gray staff or pole diagonally across his body with both hands. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or scenery, making the statue the central focus of the composition. The artist's signature, "ITHEL DOLGAN-VOIS," is visible at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Figurehead: Davy Crockett
